resources.string: Move text or small files between screens and cameras — no radio at all.

How it works
• The sender splits data into chunks and shows them as an animated sequence of QR codes. Each code carries: transfer ID, index, total and the CRC-32 of the whole content (format QT1:ID:INDEX:TOTAL:CRC32:DATA).
• Data is packed with Base45 so the QR uses alphanumeric mode (≈30 % more data per code than base64). Text is compressed (DEFLATE) when that helps.
• The receiver scans in any order, shows which chunks are missing, and verifies the CRC-32 when complete.
• Acknowledgment tone: the receiver beeps (1900 Hz) for each new chunk and plays 2850 Hz when done. With "advance on tone" the sender listens with the microphone, moves on as soon as it hears the beep, skips acknowledged chunks and stops on the done tone. Without it, the sender simply loops all chunks.
• PC → phone: open web/sender.html (single offline file) in a desktop browser.

No internet, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi or NFC is used. Keep the receiving phone ~20–40 cm from the screen; lower the speed or chunk size if scanning is slow.
